description: FROZEN v1.0 (fix plan Item 24, stream S6). One event per line in private/run-events.jsonl, the host index (SKILL71_RUNS_INDEX), the ship spool, and the Command Center ingest payload. See run-events-schema.md for the prose contract. Consumers must reject lines that fail this schema; emitters must never add fields.

artifact_hash.description: item_closed: SHA-256 hex of the item's artifact, when the item has one.

artifact_hashes.description: stage_closed: run-folder-relative artifact path to SHA-256 hex, exactly the hashes record_close stored. Hashes and paths only, never file contents.

authority_id.description: pin_drift: the external-authorities.json entry whose pin drifted (Item 11 rider).

blocked_at.description: stage_blocked / item_blocked: when the close was refused.

brand_id.description: run_initialized: copied from intake.json when present.

client.description: run_initialized: copied from intake.json when present. An identifier the operator already uses in intake, nothing more.

client_slug.description: Optional deployment slug identifying which client installation emitted the event (fleet-hostinger / fleet-contabo). The Command Center ingest token binds a slug; an event whose client_slug contradicts its token is rejected. Never a client name, email, or any PII: a slug only.

closed_at.description: stage_closed / item_closed: the close timestamp recorded by the gate.

cost.description: stage_closed: present only when the stage receipt carries cost {provider, credits_before, credits_after}.

credits_used.description: credits_before minus credits_after from the stage receipt.

duration_s.description: stage_closed: receipt finished_at minus started_at in seconds, the same value REPORT.md's Duration column is computed from; null when the receipt lacks either timestamp.

emitted_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp from the emitting host's clock at the transition.

event_id.description: UUID minted by the emitter at the moment of the transition. The dedupe key everywhere: host index, shipper, Command Center. Re-emission of the same transition reuses the same event_id; a new transition always mints a new one.

failures.description: stage_blocked / item_blocked: the gate's named failure lines, verbatim. Gate-generated strings (check names, file paths, expected values), never agent prose and never client content.

host_shape.description: Required on run_initialized (Amendment 1, Item 24 rider). Optional on later events of the same run; when present it must not contradict run_initialized.

item_id.description: item_closed / item_blocked: the Item 20 item id (review item id or runner item id, as the emitting component names it).

observed_sha.description: pin_drift: the blob SHA observed on this host; null when the pinned file is missing entirely.

overall.description: report_generated: the REPORT.json overall vocabulary (Item 25). test-run when intake.test_run is true.

page_name.description: run_initialized: copied from intake.json when present.

pinned_sha.description: pin_drift: the blob SHA recorded in external-authorities.json.

receipt_status.description: stage_closed: the status record_close stored in state.json.

report_json_path.description: report_generated: path of REPORT.json on the emitting host, so consumers never guess. Absolute, or relative to run_dir when run_dir is present.

report_md_path.description: report_generated: path of REPORT.md on the emitting host.

review_files.description: stage_closed: run-folder-relative paths of the stage's Review Receipt v2 files. Paths only; review contents never enter events.

review_mode.description: report_generated: Item 7's review-mode stamp as data (the gate's compute_review_mode result).

run_dir.description: Absolute path of the run folder on the emitting host. Present on host-index, spool, and shipped lines (the gate adds it when appending outside the run folder); optional on lines inside private/run-events.jsonl itself, where the location already says it. A path on the emitting host only: consumers store it, they never resolve it on another machine.

run_id.description: Minted by stage_gate.py cmd_init (Item 24) and stored in private/state.json. Every event of a run carries it.

scores_summary.description: Aggregate of the stage's Review Receipt v2 criteria (the gate's review_scores_summary). Aggregates only: individual criterion notes are evidence prose and never enter events.

stage.description: Stage id from references/stage-contract.json stage_order. Required on stage_closed, stage_blocked, item_closed, item_blocked.

title: Skill 71 run event (one JSONL line)
